scenarios.title: Server status
scenarios.purpose: Uptime, disks, services and network of a production server.
scenarios.excerpt:
New-BGInfo -Theme $look -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground -Width $Width -Height $Height

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'PRODUCTION  ·  SQL SERVER 2022' -Accent -FontWeight 700 -FontSize ([int](15 * $scale))
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name $server.Name -FontSize ([int](72 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    if ($fullest.Value -ge 80) {
        New-BGInfoLabel -Name "●  1 warning · $($fullest.Key) is $($fullest.Value) % full" -Status Warning -FontWeight 600
    }
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Role' -Value $server.Role
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Owner' -Value $server.Owner
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Maintenance' -Value $server.Maintenance
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'On call' -Value $server.OnCall

    # The tiles stack in the right column; three panels share the bottom band.
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas -Region Right -Tile $tiles

    $band = @{ Region = 'Bottom'; Height = [int](300 * $scale); NoHistory = $true }
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'volumes' -Title 'Volumes used' -Kind ProgressBar `
        -Values @($server.Volumes.Values) -Labels @($server.Volumes.Keys) -Maximum 100 `
        -ValueSuffix ' %' -NoProgressHandles -ShowLatestValue:$false -WarningThreshold 80 -CriticalThreshold 90
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'network' -Title 'Network' -Kind Area -Values $server.Network `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 4 -ValueSuffix ' Mbps'
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'services' -Title 'Critical services' -Kind Pictorial `
        -Values $server.Services.Running, $server.Services.Stopped -Labels 'Running', 'Stopped' `
        -Palette $look.Ok, $look.Critical -PictorialSymbol Circle -PictorialColumns 12 `
        -Maximum ($server.Services.Running + $server.Services.Stopped) -ShowDataLabels -ShowLatestValue:$false
} -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "server-status-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
#endregion
scenarios.source:
<#
    Server status wallpaper: who the server is, how long it has been up,
    and whether disks, services and the network need attention.

    The data block returns plain values; the presentation block only reads
    them. Sample values keep the render reproducible, and each one notes the
    command that supplies it on a real server.
#>
param(
    [ValidateSet('Light', 'Dark')]
    [string] $Theme = 'Dark',
    [int] $Width = 1920,
    [int] $Height = 1080,
    [string] $OutputDirectory = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output')
)

Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\PowerBGInfo.psd1') -Force

#region Data: your logic goes here
function Get-ServerStatus {
    [pscustomobject] @{
        Name        = 'SQL-PROD-01'
        Role        = 'Primary replica · AG-FINANCE'
        Owner       = 'Data Platform team'
        Maintenance = 'Sunday 02:00–04:00 UTC'
        OnCall      = 'dba-oncall@contoso.com'
        # (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime
        Uptime      = New-TimeSpan -Days 41 -Hours 6
        # Get-Volume | Where-Object DriveLetter
        Volumes     = [ordered] @{ 'C: System' = 61; 'D: Data' = 88; 'L: Logs' = 47 }
        # Get-Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time'
        Cpu         = @(12, 28, 19, 44, 31, 38, 27, 23)
        Memory      = @{ UsedGB = 100; TotalGB = 128 }
        # Get-Counter '\Network Interface(*)\Bytes Total/sec'
        Network     = @(180, 210, 260, 240, 310, 420, 380, 350, 300, 312)
        # Get-Service for the services that matter on this server
        Services    = @{ Running = 11; Stopped = 1 }
    }
}

# A slow or broken source must not block logon: time-box it and fall back.
$server = Invoke-BGInfoDataSource -Name 'Server status' -TimeoutSeconds 15 -ScriptBlock ${function:Get-ServerStatus} -Default ([pscustomobject] @{
        Name = $env:COMPUTERNAME; Role = 'unknown'; Owner = 'unknown'; Maintenance = 'unknown'; OnCall = 'unknown'
        Uptime = [timespan]::Zero; Volumes = @{ 'C:' = 0 }; Cpu = @(0); Memory = @{ UsedGB = 0; TotalGB = 1 }; Network = @(0)
        Services = @{ Running = 0; Stopped = 0 }
    })
#endregion

#region Presentation: reads only $server
$scale = [Math]::Round($Height / 1080, 2)
$look = New-BGInfoTheme Aurora -Mode $Theme -Scale $scale
$fullest = $server.Volumes.GetEnumerator() | Sort-Object Value -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
$memory = $server.Memory.UsedGB / $server.Memory.TotalGB

$tile = @{ SurfaceStyle = 'Glass' }
$tiles = @(
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Terminal -Label 'UPTIME' `
        -Value "$($server.Uptime.Days) days $($server.Uptime.Hours) h" `
        -Detail 'Since the September patch window' -Status Ok
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Cpu -Label 'CPU' `
        -Value "$($server.Cpu[-1]) %" -Detail '16 cores · 2.9 GHz' `
        -MiniChartKind Area -MiniChartValues $server.Cpu -MiniChartMaximum 100
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Memory -Label 'MEMORY' `
        -Value "$($server.Memory.UsedGB) of $($server.Memory.TotalGB) GB" -Detail 'SQL Server buffer pool' `
        -Progress $memory -StatusValue ($memory * 100) -WarningThreshold 75 -CriticalThreshold 90
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Network -Label 'NETWORK' `
        -Value "$($server.Network[-1]) Mbps" -Detail '10.40.12.21 · 10 GbE' `
        -MiniChartKind Sparkline -MiniChartValues $server.Network
)

New-BGInfo -Theme $look -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground -Width $Width -Height $Height

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'PRODUCTION  ·  SQL SERVER 2022' -Accent -FontWeight 700 -FontSize ([int](15 * $scale))
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name $server.Name -FontSize ([int](72 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    if ($fullest.Value -ge 80) {
        New-BGInfoLabel -Name "●  1 warning · $($fullest.Key) is $($fullest.Value) % full" -Status Warning -FontWeight 600
    }
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Role' -Value $server.Role
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Owner' -Value $server.Owner
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Maintenance' -Value $server.Maintenance
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'On call' -Value $server.OnCall

    # The tiles stack in the right column; three panels share the bottom band.
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas -Region Right -Tile $tiles

    $band = @{ Region = 'Bottom'; Height = [int](300 * $scale); NoHistory = $true }
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'volumes' -Title 'Volumes used' -Kind ProgressBar `
        -Values @($server.Volumes.Values) -Labels @($server.Volumes.Keys) -Maximum 100 `
        -ValueSuffix ' %' -NoProgressHandles -ShowLatestValue:$false -WarningThreshold 80 -CriticalThreshold 90
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'network' -Title 'Network' -Kind Area -Values $server.Network `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 4 -ValueSuffix ' Mbps'
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'services' -Title 'Critical services' -Kind Pictorial `
        -Values $server.Services.Running, $server.Services.Stopped -Labels 'Running', 'Stopped' `
        -Palette $look.Ok, $look.Critical -PictorialSymbol Circle -PictorialColumns 12 `
        -Maximum ($server.Services.Running + $server.Services.Stopped) -ShowDataLabels -ShowLatestValue:$false
} -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "server-status-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
#endregion
features: Generated gradient background with glows and a grid
Visual canvas info tiles with mini charts
Progress bar, area and pictorial charts on shared panels

scenarios.title: Help desk
scenarios.purpose: How to get help, plus the details support asks for.
scenarios.excerpt:
New-BGInfo -Theme (New-BGInfoTheme Orchid -Mode $Theme -Scale $scale) -TextPosition MiddleLeft -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground -Width $Width -Height $Height
    # The tile column sits vertically centered beside the centered text.
    New-BGInfoLayout -ColumnAlignment Center

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'IT SERVICE DESK' -Accent -FontSize ([int](16 * $scale)) -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Need help?' -FontSize ([int](88 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Call 555-0100, extension 4357' -Accent -FontSize ([int](40 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Have the asset tag on the right ready.' -Muted -FontSize ([int](22 * $scale))
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Portal' -Value 'help.contoso.com'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Teams' -Value '#it-help'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Walk-in' -Value 'Building B, room 012'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Hours' -Value 'Monday–Friday, 07:00–19:00'

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name ' ' -FontSize ([int](12 * $scale))
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'SERVICE STATUS' -Accent -FontSize ([int](16 * $scale)) -FontWeight 700
    foreach ($service in $facts.Services) {
        New-BGInfoLabel -Name "●  $($service.Text)" -Status $service.Status -FontSize ([int](19 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    }

    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas -Region Right -Tile $tiles
} -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "helpdesk-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
#endregion
scenarios.source:
<#
    Help-desk wallpaper for shared or front-desk PCs. It tells people how
    to get help and shows the details the service desk asks for first.

    The data block returns plain values; the presentation block only reads
    them. Sample values keep the render reproducible, and each one notes the
    command that supplies it on a real machine.
#>
param(
    [ValidateSet('Light', 'Dark')]
    [string] $Theme = 'Light',
    [int] $Width = 1920,
    [int] $Height = 1080,
    [string] $OutputDirectory = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output')
)

Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\PowerBGInfo.psd1') -Force

#region Data: your logic goes here
function Get-HelpDeskFacts {
    [pscustomobject] @{
        # (Get-CimInstance Win32_SystemEnclosure).SMBIOSAssetTag
        AssetTag     = 'CT-04217'
        ComputerName = 'FRONTDESK-07'
        Location     = 'Reception, B1'
        # (Get-NetIPConfiguration | Where-Object IPv4DefaultGateway).IPv4Address.IPAddress
        IPAddress    = '10.20.4.37'
        Network      = 'Wired · VLAN 120'
        SignedInAs   = 'Reception (shared)'
        # (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).Caption and .BuildNumber
        Windows      = '11 Enterprise 24H2'
        Build        = '26100'
        # Your monitoring or status-page API
        Services     = @(
            @{ Text = 'Email, Teams, Wi-Fi and VPN are working'; Status = 'Ok' }
            @{ Text = 'Floor 2 printers are offline until 14:00'; Status = 'Warning' }
        )
    }
}

$facts = Invoke-BGInfoDataSource -Name 'Help-desk facts' -TimeoutSeconds 10 -ScriptBlock ${function:Get-HelpDeskFacts} -Default ([pscustomobject] @{
        AssetTag = 'unknown'; ComputerName = $env:COMPUTERNAME; Location = 'unknown'; IPAddress = 'unknown'; Network = ''
        SignedInAs = 'unknown'; Windows = 'unknown'; Build = ''; Services = @(@{ Text = 'Service status is unavailable'; Status = 'Info' })
    })
#endregion

#region Presentation: reads only $facts
$scale = [Math]::Round($Height / 1080, 2)
$tile = @{ SurfaceStyle = 'Glass' }
$tiles = @(
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Shield -Label 'ASSET TAG' -Value $facts.AssetTag -Detail 'Sticker under the keyboard'
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Computer -Label 'COMPUTER NAME' -Value $facts.ComputerName -Detail $facts.Location
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Network -Label 'IP ADDRESS' -Value $facts.IPAddress -Detail $facts.Network
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind User -Label 'SIGNED IN AS' -Value $facts.SignedInAs -Detail 'Resets at sign-out'
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind OperatingSystem -Label 'WINDOWS' -Value $facts.Windows -Detail "Build $($facts.Build)"
)

New-BGInfo -Theme (New-BGInfoTheme Orchid -Mode $Theme -Scale $scale) -TextPosition MiddleLeft -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground -Width $Width -Height $Height
    # The tile column sits vertically centered beside the centered text.
    New-BGInfoLayout -ColumnAlignment Center

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'IT SERVICE DESK' -Accent -FontSize ([int](16 * $scale)) -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Need help?' -FontSize ([int](88 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Call 555-0100, extension 4357' -Accent -FontSize ([int](40 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Have the asset tag on the right ready.' -Muted -FontSize ([int](22 * $scale))
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Portal' -Value 'help.contoso.com'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Teams' -Value '#it-help'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Walk-in' -Value 'Building B, room 012'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Hours' -Value 'Monday–Friday, 07:00–19:00'

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name ' ' -FontSize ([int](12 * $scale))
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'SERVICE STATUS' -Accent -FontSize ([int](16 * $scale)) -FontWeight 700
    foreach ($service in $facts.Services) {
        New-BGInfoLabel -Name "●  $($service.Text)" -Status $service.Status -FontSize ([int](19 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    }

    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas -Region Right -Tile $tiles
} -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "helpdesk-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
#endregion

Visual canvas info tiles with built-in icons

scenarios.title: Lab or classroom
scenarios.purpose: Seat name, reset schedule and lab progress for students.
scenarios.excerpt:
New-BGInfo -Theme (New-BGInfoTheme Ember -Mode $Theme -Scale $scale) -TextPosition TopCenter -SpaceY ([int](120 * $scale)) -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground -Width $Width -Height $Height

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name $lab.Course -Accent -FontSize ([int](18 * $scale)) -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name $lab.Seat -FontSize ([int](150 * $scale)) -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'This PC resets every night at 02:00.' -FontSize ([int](30 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Save your work to OneDrive before you leave.' -Muted -FontSize ([int](24 * $scale))
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name ' ' -FontSize ([int](10 * $scale))
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Instructor' -Value $lab.Instructor
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Wi-Fi' -Value $lab.Wifi
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Need a hand?' -Value 'Raise your hand or call 4357'

    # Three fixed-width panels sit centered in the bottom band; the gauge turns amber in the last 15 minutes.
    $band = @{ Region = 'Bottom'; Height = [int](250 * $scale); NoHistory = $true }
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'time' -Width ([int](360 * $scale)) -Title 'Session time left' -Kind Gauge -Values $lab.MinutesLeft `
        -Maximum $lab.SessionTotal -ValueSuffix ' min' -ShowLatestValue:$false `
        -WarningThreshold 15 -CriticalThreshold 5 -ThresholdDirection Below
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'exercises' -Width ([int](420 * $scale)) -Title 'Your exercises' -Kind Pictorial -Values $lab.Completed `
        -Labels 'Completed' -Palette $second -PictorialSymbol Star -PictorialColumns $lab.Exercises `
        -Maximum $lab.Exercises -ShowDataLabels -ShowLatestValue:$false
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'class' -Width ([int](360 * $scale)) -Title "Class · exercises 1–$($lab.Exercises)" -Kind Bar -Values $lab.ClassDone `
        -LineColor $second -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 3 -ShowLatestValue:$false
} -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "classroom-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
#endregion
scenarios.source:
<#
    Lab or classroom wallpaper. The seat name is readable from the back of
    the room, students see when the machine resets, and the instructor sees
    lab progress at a glance.

    The data block returns plain values; the presentation block only reads
    them. Replace the samples with your lab schedule, timetable or LMS data.
#>
param(
    [ValidateSet('Light', 'Dark')]
    [string] $Theme = 'Light',
    [int] $Width = 1920,
    [int] $Height = 1080,
    [string] $OutputDirectory = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output')
)

Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\PowerBGInfo.psd1') -Force

#region Data: your logic goes here
function Get-ClassroomData {
    [pscustomobject] @{
        Course       = 'LAB B  ·  INTRODUCTION TO POWERSHELL'
        Seat         = 'LAB-B-14'
        Instructor   = 'Anna Novak'
        Wifi         = 'CAMPUS-LAB, sign in with your ID'
        MinutesLeft  = 35
        SessionTotal = 90
        Completed    = 3
        Exercises    = 5
        # Students who finished each exercise, from the LMS gradebook.

$lab = Invoke-BGInfoDataSource -Name 'Classroom data' -TimeoutSeconds 10 -ScriptBlock ${function:Get-ClassroomData} -Default ([pscustomobject] @{
        Course = 'LAB'; Seat = $env:COMPUTERNAME; Instructor = 'unknown'; Wifi = 'unknown'
        MinutesLeft = 0; SessionTotal = 90; Completed = 0; Exercises = 5; ClassDone = @(0)

#endregion

#region Presentation: reads only $lab
$scale = [Math]::Round($Height / 1080, 2)
$second = (New-BGInfoTheme Ember -Mode $Theme).SecondaryAccent

New-BGInfo -Theme (New-BGInfoTheme Ember -Mode $Theme -Scale $scale) -TextPosition TopCenter -SpaceY ([int](120 * $scale)) -Target File {

    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Need a hand?' -Value 'Raise your hand or call 4357'

    # Three fixed-width panels sit centered in the bottom band; the gauge turns amber in the last 15 minutes.
    $band = @{ Region = 'Bottom'; Height = [int](250 * $scale); NoHistory = $true }
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'time' -Width ([int](360 * $scale)) -Title 'Session time left' -Kind Gauge -Values $lab.MinutesLeft `
        -Maximum $lab.SessionTotal -ValueSuffix ' min' -ShowLatestValue:$false `
        -WarningThreshold 15 -CriticalThreshold 5 -ThresholdDirection Below
    New-BGInfoChart @band -Id 'exercises' -Width ([int](420 * $scale)) -Title 'Your exercises' -Kind Pictorial -Values $lab.Completed `
        -Labels 'Completed' -Palette $second -PictorialSymbol Star -PictorialColumns $lab.Exercises `

scenarios.title: Admin workstation
scenarios.purpose: Dense privileged-access HUD with the allowed admin path.
scenarios.excerpt:
New-BGInfo -Theme $look -SpaceX $textX -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground -Width $Width -Height $Height

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'TIER 0  ·  PRIVILEGED ACCESS WORKSTATION' -Status Critical -FontSize ([int](15 * $scale)) -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name $paw.Name -FontSize ([int](64 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'No email, no browsing, no personal accounts.' -FontSize ([int](19 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Operator' -Value $paw.Operator
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Domain' -Value $paw.Domain
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Reachable' -Value 'Jump host → tier 0 only'

    # The theme puts the canvas rails on its margins; only the tile size is set here.
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas -Tile ($tiles | ForEach-Object { $_.Side = 'Left'; $_ }) -LeftTileWidth $railWidth -TileHeight $tileHeight

    New-BGInfoChart -Id 'signins' -Title 'Privileged sign-ins' -Kind Bar -Values $paw.SignIns `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 3 -ValueSuffix ' today' -NoHistory `
        -Width ([int](560 * $scale)) -Height ([int](270 * $scale)) -Anchor TopRight -OffsetX $look.MarginX -OffsetY $look.MarginY

    New-BGInfoTopology -Title 'Allowed admin path' -Subtitle '2 hops to tier 0' -Layout DenseGrouped `
        -Scale ($(if ($Height -ge 1440) { 2 } else { 1 })) -NodeDisplayMode Card -Width $column -Height $diagramHeight `
        -Anchor TopRight -OffsetX $look.MarginX -OffsetY $diagramTop -TopologyDefinition {
        $node = @{ Status = 'Healthy' }
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 'paw' -Label 'This workstation'
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 'jump' -Label 'Jump hosts'
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 't0' -Label 'Tier 0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'paw' -Label $paw.Name -Subtitle 'Windows 11' -Kind Endpoint -GroupId 'paw'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'jmp' -Label 'JMP-T0-01' -Subtitle 'Server 2025' -Kind Gateway -GroupId 'jump'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'dc1' -Label 'DC01' -Subtitle 'PDC emulator' -Kind Server -GroupId 't0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'ca' -Label 'CA01' -Subtitle 'Enterprise CA' -Kind Certificate -GroupId 't0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode -Id 'dc2' -Label 'DC02' -Subtitle 'Replica' -Kind Server -GroupId 't0' -Status Warning
        $link = @{ Kind = 'Connectivity'; Status = 'Healthy' }
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'paw' -TargetNodeId 'jmp' -Label 'RDP + MFA' -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'jmp' -TargetNodeId 'dc1' -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'jmp' -TargetNodeId 'ca' -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge -SourceNodeId 'dc1' -TargetNodeId 'dc2' -Label $paw.ReplicaLag -Kind Replication -Status Warning
    }

    $bottom = @{ Anchor = 'BottomRight'; Width = $half; Height = $bottomHeight; OffsetY = $look.MarginY; NoHistory = $true }
    New-BGInfoChart @bottom -Id 'changes' -Title 'Tier 0 changes' -Kind Area -Values $paw.Changes `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 3 -ValueSuffix ' this hour' -OffsetX ($look.MarginX + $half + $look.Gap)
    New-BGInfoChart @bottom -Id 'alerts' -Title 'Open security alerts' -Kind ProgressBar -Values @($paw.Alerts.Values) `
        -Labels @($paw.Alerts.Keys) -Palette $look.Critical, $look.Warning, $look.Accent -Maximum 10 `
        -NoProgressHandles -ShowLatestValue:$false -OffsetX $look.MarginX
} -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "admin-workstation-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
#endregion
scenarios.data:
#region Data: your logic goes here
function Get-AdminWorkstationData {
    [pscustomobject] @{
        Name          = 'PAW-T0-03'
        Operator      = 'adm.jsmith'
        Domain        = 'corp.contoso.com'
        # Get-Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time'
        Cpu           = @(9, 14, 31, 22, 12, 18)
        Memory        = @(28, 30, 29, 31, 30, 30)
        SystemFreeGB  = 212
        SystemUsed    = 0.41
        # Get-MpComputerStatus
        Defender      = 'Protected'
        # Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn | Select-Object -Last 1
        PatchLevel    = 'October 2026'
        # Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My | Sort-Object NotAfter
        SmartCardDays = 27
        Elevation     = 'JIT until 16:40'
        # Last 7 days from the Security log, event 4672.
        SignIns       = @(4, 6, 3, 9, 5, 2, 7)
        Changes       = @(2, 1, 4, 3, 8, 5, 3, 2, 6, 4)
        Alerts        = [ordered] @{ High = 1; Medium = 3; Low = 6 }
        ReplicaLag    = '14 min lag'
    }
}

$paw = Invoke-BGInfoDataSource -Name 'Workstation data' -TimeoutSeconds 15 -ScriptBlock ${function:Get-AdminWorkstationData} -Default ([pscustomobject] @{
        Name = $env:COMPUTERNAME; Operator = $env:USERNAME; Domain = 'unknown'; Cpu = @(0); Memory = @(0); SystemFreeGB = 0; SystemUsed = 0
        Defender = 'unknown'; PatchLevel = 'unknown'; SmartCardDays = 0; Elevation = 'unknown'; SignIns = @(0); Changes = @(0)
        Alerts = [ordered] @{ High = 0 }; ReplicaLag = ''
    })
#endregion
scenarios.source:
<#
    Privileged access workstation. A dense, dark HUD for administrators:
    health tiles with recent trends, the tier 0 path this machine is allowed
    to reach, and the privileged activity worth a second look.

    The data block returns plain values; the presentation block only reads
    them. Comments name the command or source that supplies each value.
#>
param(
    [ValidateSet('Light', 'Dark')]
    [string] $Theme = 'Dark',
    [int] $Width = 1920,
    [int] $Height = 1080,
    [string] $OutputDirectory = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output')
)

Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\PowerBGInfo.psd1') -Force

#region Data: your logic goes here
function Get-AdminWorkstationData {
    [pscustomobject] @{
        Name          = 'PAW-T0-03'
        Operator      = 'adm.jsmith'
        Domain        = 'corp.contoso.com'
        # Get-Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time'
        Cpu           = @(9, 14, 31, 22, 12, 18)
        Memory        = @(28, 30, 29, 31, 30, 30)
        SystemFreeGB  = 212
        SystemUsed    = 0.41
        # Get-MpComputerStatus
        Defender      = 'Protected'
        # Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn | Select-Object -Last 1
        PatchLevel    = 'October 2026'
        # Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My | Sort-Object NotAfter
        SmartCardDays = 27
        Elevation     = 'JIT until 16:40'
        # Last 7 days from the Security log, event 4672.
        SignIns       = @(4, 6, 3, 9, 5, 2, 7)
        Changes       = @(2, 1, 4, 3, 8, 5, 3, 2, 6, 4)
        Alerts        = [ordered] @{ High = 1; Medium = 3; Low = 6 }
        ReplicaLag    = '14 min lag'
    }
}

$paw = Invoke-BGInfoDataSource -Name 'Workstation data' -TimeoutSeconds 15 -ScriptBlock ${function:Get-AdminWorkstationData} -Default ([pscustomobject] @{
        Name = $env:COMPUTERNAME; Operator = $env:USERNAME; Domain = 'unknown'; Cpu = @(0); Memory = @(0); SystemFreeGB = 0; SystemUsed = 0
        Defender = 'unknown'; PatchLevel = 'unknown'; SmartCardDays = 0; Elevation = 'unknown'; SignIns = @(0); Changes = @(0)
        Alerts = [ordered] @{ High = 0 }; ReplicaLag = ''
    })
#endregion

#region Presentation: reads only $paw
$scale = [Math]::Round($Height / 1080, 2)
$look = New-BGInfoTheme Midnight -Mode $Theme -Scale $scale

$tile = @{ SurfaceStyle = 'Glass' }
$tiles = @(
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Cpu -Label 'CPU' -Value "$($paw.Cpu[-1]) %" `
        -Detail '8 cores · Credential Guard on' -MiniChartKind Area -MiniChartValues $paw.Cpu -MiniChartMaximum 100
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Memory -Label 'MEMORY' -Value '9.6 of 32 GB' `
        -Detail 'Hyper-V isolation' -MiniChartKind Bars -MiniChartValues $paw.Memory -MiniChartMaximum 100
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Storage -Label 'SYSTEM DRIVE' -Value "$($paw.SystemFreeGB) GB free" `
        -Detail 'BitLocker · TPM + PIN' -Progress $paw.SystemUsed
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Shield -Label 'DEFENDER' -Value $paw.Defender `
        -Detail 'Signatures 2 h old' -Status Ok
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind OperatingSystem -Label 'PATCH LEVEL' -Value $paw.PatchLevel `
        -Detail 'Ring 0 · pilot' -Status Ok
    # Fewer than 30 days left is a warning, fewer than 7 is critical.
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Domain -Label 'SMART CARD' -Value "Expires in $($paw.SmartCardDays) days" `
        -Detail 'Renew before 11 Nov' -StatusValue $paw.SmartCardDays -WarningThreshold 30 -CriticalThreshold 7 -ThresholdDirection Below
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Terminal -Label 'ELEVATION' -Value $paw.Elevation `
        -Detail 'Approved by S. Ortiz' -Status Warning
)

# Seven tiles fill the left rail from the top margin to the bottom margin.
$railWidth = [int](460 * $scale)
$tileHeight = [Math]::Floor(($Height - 2 * $look.MarginY - 6 * $look.TileGap) / 7)
# The text block and the content column start right of the rail.
$textX = 2 * $look.MarginX + $railWidth
$column = $Width - $textX - $look.MarginX
$half = [int](($column - $look.Gap) / 2)
$bottomHeight = [int](210 * $scale)
$diagramTop = [int](360 * $scale)
$diagramHeight = $Height - $diagramTop - $look.MarginY - $bottomHeight - 32

New-BGInfo -Theme $look -SpaceX $textX -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground -Width $Width -Height $Height

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'TIER 0  ·  PRIVILEGED ACCESS WORKSTATION' -Status Critical -FontSize ([int](15 * $scale)) -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name $paw.Name -FontSize ([int](64 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'No email, no browsing, no personal accounts.' -FontSize ([int](19 * $scale)) -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Operator' -Value $paw.Operator
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Domain' -Value $paw.Domain
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Reachable' -Value 'Jump host → tier 0 only'

    # The theme puts the canvas rails on its margins; only the tile size is set here.
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas -Tile ($tiles | ForEach-Object { $_.Side = 'Left'; $_ }) -LeftTileWidth $railWidth -TileHeight $tileHeight

    New-BGInfoChart -Id 'signins' -Title 'Privileged sign-ins' -Kind Bar -Values $paw.SignIns `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 3 -ValueSuffix ' today' -NoHistory `
        -Width ([int](560 * $scale)) -Height ([int](270 * $scale)) -Anchor TopRight -OffsetX $look.MarginX -OffsetY $look.MarginY

    New-BGInfoTopology -Title 'Allowed admin path' -Subtitle '2 hops to tier 0' -Layout DenseGrouped `
        -Scale ($(if ($Height -ge 1440) { 2 } else { 1 })) -NodeDisplayMode Card -Width $column -Height $diagramHeight `
        -Anchor TopRight -OffsetX $look.MarginX -OffsetY $diagramTop -TopologyDefinition {
        $node = @{ Status = 'Healthy' }
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 'paw' -Label 'This workstation'
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 'jump' -Label 'Jump hosts'
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 't0' -Label 'Tier 0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'paw' -Label $paw.Name -Subtitle 'Windows 11' -Kind Endpoint -GroupId 'paw'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'jmp' -Label 'JMP-T0-01' -Subtitle 'Server 2025' -Kind Gateway -GroupId 'jump'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'dc1' -Label 'DC01' -Subtitle 'PDC emulator' -Kind Server -GroupId 't0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'ca' -Label 'CA01' -Subtitle 'Enterprise CA' -Kind Certificate -GroupId 't0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode -Id 'dc2' -Label 'DC02' -Subtitle 'Replica' -Kind Server -GroupId 't0' -Status Warning
        $link = @{ Kind = 'Connectivity'; Status = 'Healthy' }
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'paw' -TargetNodeId 'jmp' -Label 'RDP + MFA' -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'jmp' -TargetNodeId 'dc1' -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'jmp' -TargetNodeId 'ca' -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge -SourceNodeId 'dc1' -TargetNodeId 'dc2' -Label $paw.ReplicaLag -Kind Replication -Status Warning
    }

    $bottom = @{ Anchor = 'BottomRight'; Width = $half; Height = $bottomHeight; OffsetY = $look.MarginY; NoHistory = $true }
    New-BGInfoChart @bottom -Id 'changes' -Title 'Tier 0 changes' -Kind Area -Values $paw.Changes `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 3 -ValueSuffix ' this hour' -OffsetX ($look.MarginX + $half + $look.Gap)
    New-BGInfoChart @bottom -Id 'alerts' -Title 'Open security alerts' -Kind ProgressBar -Values @($paw.Alerts.Values) `
        -Labels @($paw.Alerts.Keys) -Palette $look.Critical, $look.Warning, $look.Accent -Maximum 10 `
        -NoProgressHandles -ShowLatestValue:$false -OffsetX $look.MarginX
} -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "admin-workstation-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
#endregion
features: Topology diagram with groups, status and replication
Visual canvas info tiles with mini charts and progress
Bar, area and progress bar charts on shared panels
